description: The finite-root Torelli theorem is complete; the remaining compactification problem is to glue it across strata where deleted roots escape to infinity.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: Extend the finite-root all-multiplicity classification across strata where deleted roots escape to c=infinity and the number of finite marked planes changes.
members.title: Glue Cubic-Frame Torelli Across Roots Escaping to Infinity

members.statement: For admissible cubic frames with nonconstant A/c, stable left-right equivalence, ordinary left-right equivalence, and equality of the decorated Artin schemes (Spec C[c]/(A/c), B mod (A/c)) up to scaling are equivalent, without squarefreeness or coprimality assumptions.
members.title: All-Multiplicity Fixed-Frame Torelli

members.statement: At ambient bound N, degree-preserving cubic-frame root translations are exactly the kernel pair of (Qhat,P) mapping to (Qhat,z^N P mod Qhat); when roots escape to infinity, P decomposes uniquely into finite-root data plus the translated principal part.
members.title: One Polynomial Map Encodes Every Bounded Root-Translation Orbit

members.statement: For a kernel-of-an-endomorphism translation action over a Q-algebra, the invariant algebra is the kernel of the relative differential modulo im(M dual); for the bounded cubic-frame action, global invariants are the contraction of the localization at the single one-root wall q_N=0.
members.title: The Cubic-Frame Categorical Quotient Is a Differential Kernel Controlled by One Wall

members.statement: The rank-one wall orbit sheaf B/Ann_B(pi^e) fails the strong Rim-Schlessinger pushout condition, so it is not an algebraic space; consequently the free quotient stack and the bounded cubic-frame fppf quotient along the generic one-root wall are not algebraic.
members.title: The Bounded Cubic-Frame fppf Orbit Quotient Is Not Algebraic

members.statement: At a simple escape wall the graph closure is the blowup of the corresponding weighted ideal, and for an escape of length m the principal-part coordinates give a finite-type projective separated weighted degeneration space with weights (1,...,m,m+1,m,...,2).
members.title: Weighted Graph Closures Give Separated Spaces of Cubic-Frame Degenerations

source_treatment: The linked working manuscript has exact locations for every program-relevant defining claim on this page. This says where the claims are recorded, not that they have been independently verified.
statement: Compactify the all-multiplicity cubic-frame classification across degenerations in which deleted roots move to \(c=\infty\), so the number of finite marked planes changes, and compare the resulting boundary with the \(\alpha=0\) stratum.
title: Gluing Cubic-Frame Torelli at Infinity
